title: Split the reverse_survivors test files under the 250-line cap
objective: Bring sim.test.ts (698) and director.test.ts (315) under the cap by partitioning at describe boundaries, and establish that its two core source files cannot be split without breaking a runtime dependency.
acceptance_criteria: No reverse_survivors test file is over 250 lines.
The suite still reports exactly 160 passing tests.
npx tsc --noEmit and npx eslint . --max-warnings 0 both pass, with no new suppression.
No test is deleted, skipped or weakened; whole describe blocks move verbatim.
sim.ts and types.ts are fully restored, leaving no partial split and no orphan module.
out_of_scope: sim.ts, whose exported step() calls survivorStep and the enemy helpers that any seam would move.
types.ts, whose difficulty tables are referenced by the type declarations above them.
verifier: npm test -- --run (expects exactly 160 passed), npx tsc --noEmit, npx eslint . --max-warnings 0, and check_file_length.sh over reverse_survivors.
